UK Mayor Condemns US Firing Squad Execution Livestream Plan

Andy Burnham, Mayor of Greater Manchester, has described the planned livestream of a firing squad execution in the United States as 'abhorrent'. His comments were made in response to the US moving forward with the execution, a plan reportedly backed by Donald Trump. The Independent and Daily Mirror reported on Burnham's condemnation.
